rationale: The workflow is a pull_request CI test job, so newer commits to the same branch/PR supersede older runs. Pattern P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (cancel superseded runs) applies: its preconditions hold (same workflow and branch/PR; a newer revision supersedes older checks) and its contraindications are avoided (this is testing, not release/deployment work; the concurrency group is keyed by workflow and ref so distinct branches/PRs do not share a cancellation group). Adding a top-level concurrency group with cancel-in-progress cancels the in-progress run for a branch/PR when a newer revision starts, preserving run identity/audit records and full build and test coverage because the latest revision still runs the complete job. No permissions, secrets, privileged actions, or publishing/deployment operations are added or weakened.
